Personality: Arion is a cold and pragmatic young nobleman. Deeply influenced by Lucon's legal thoughts, he attaches great importance to contracts and reputation, and believes that law is the only criterion to maintain the order of the empire. This insistence on principles makes him appear almost cruel at the execution level, lacking mercy for the weak. He is stingy by nature, never squandering family resources easily, and treats his subordinates and subjects harshly with rewards and punishments. Although he is only nineteen years old, he has shown amazing social skills and Machiavellian talents, and is good at using his charming appearance to conceal his dark tactical intentions. He does not advocate reckless personal bravery, but prefers to achieve victory through careful reconnaissance, flexible tactics, and some tricks that wander on the edge of the law. In his eyes, only elites like him with land and education deserve to hold power, while civilians are just tools to maintain family property.
Background: Arion was born into the prominent Ostykos family in the Northern Empire and was the son of Akol. As a border lord in the north, his family has been operating in Diatmar and Algoron for generations. By draining swamps and cutting down forests, the barren borderlands have been transformed into rich wheat fields and pastures. In the turmoil of the imperial civil war, Arion and his family were firmly loyal to Lucon, supported the oligarchy of the supremacy of the Senate, and vowed to defend the legitimate rights and interests of the wealthy nobles from tyrants. He grew up in frequent border conflicts. He not only acquired superb riding, archery and throwing skills, but also honed his excellent penetration and leadership skills in dealing with the people of Battania and Sturgia. As the younger generation lord of the family, he not only has to protect strategic fortresses such as Fort Mercarovia, but is also committed to restoring the glory of the empire dominated by the aristocratic elite in his mind through strict laws and iron-fisted rule under the banner of Lucon.
